# OpenXR Android loader

The `openxr/` directory contains the official Khronos OpenXR Android loader AAR,
version **1.1.65**, extracted without modification.

Source: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/khronos/openxr/openxr_loader_for_android/1.1.65/openxr_loader_for_android-1.1.65.aar

SHA-256: `a298c326085b09181c85235fb04d37510939bd30938ed4322c093c09780e8643`

License: the upstream license is retained in `openxr/META-INF/LICENSE`.
`scripts/build.ps1` can download and verify this exact dependency if missing.

Source exports also retain that notice under `licenses/OpenXR-LICENSE.txt`.
Three.js and Android NDK notices are retained in `licenses/`; see the root
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for how they are used and included in APK builds.
